name: MyPlots
whyThisMatters:
It's for nights out. Not a tool a venue logs into once a month and forgets. Two doors. One if you want to find something nearby and buy a ticket. One if you want to put an event up, run it, and take the money on the same site.

Look at what's actually listed. Campus shows, club nights, after-parties, local live sets. A city and a start time on the card. Not conferences. Not class bookings. A specific evening, and a person deciding if they're going.

So a monthly seat would be the wrong way to read the business. Hosts get paid when a ticket sells. People pay for the ticket, not for a login to browse. Find the night, grab the ticket, done. Host tools are the other half, so they don't need a separate box office.

That's why the money shows up as cash and the recurring number sits at zero. The cash is tickets for a night, not a subscription someone forgot to cancel.

The person throwing the night doesn't need a ticket site plus a separate page plus a payment link. Attendees see a card with a time and a city, and they buy. Hosting and buying are the same place. That's the loop.
